home.tagline: MCP servers, explained before you install.
home.staticAnalysis: Static analysis: MCPlain reads the code of the server, it never runs it.

form.label: MCP server to check
form.hint: A GitHub link, an npx command or a uvx command, 500 characters at most.
form.empty: Paste a GitHub link, an npx command or a uvx command.
form.busy: The queue is full, try again in a minute.
form.unavailable: MCPlain does not answer right now. Try again in a few minutes.

unverified.title: The MCPlain service did not answer.
unverified.body: It did not answer, or it answered something unexpected: nothing is said about this server.

timeout.title: The analysis is taking too long.
timeout.body: Run it again, or try again in a few minutes.

grayStates.notSafe: This does not mean this MCP is safe.

plain.heading: IN PLAIN WORDS
plain.canDoNothing: Its code lights no lamp: nothing special was found.
plain.morePoints: {count, plural, one {And # more point to check below.} other {And # more points to check below.}}
plain.foundNothingDomains: Nothing dangerous. It only goes to: {domains}
plain.adviceNothing: Nothing stands in the way. Check each new version again.

lamps.heading: THE LAMPS
lamps.count: {lit, plural, =0 {None lit out of {total}} other {# lit out of {total}}}

intro.red: {count, plural, one {This point alone gives the red verdict.} other {Each of these points alone gives the red verdict.}}
intro.orange: These points do not prove a trap, but they need your attention before you install.

points.emptyGreen: Nothing to check. All the code was read and followed, and nothing powerful or hidden was found.
points.emptyGray: No point to check was found, but not all the code could be read.

tools.heading: {count, plural, =0 {NO TOOL} one {THE TOOL} other {THE # TOOLS}}
tools.hint: Click a tool to open its sheet.

sheet.moreAlerts: {count, plural, one {And # more point for this tool, in the list above.} other {And # more points for this tool, in the list above.}}
sheet.dynamicDescription: Its description is built at startup: it could not be read.
sheet.nothing: Nothing special: its code lights no lamp.
sheet.nowhere: No precise place was recorded for this tool.
sheet.morePlaces: {count, plural, one {and # more place} other {and # more places}}

details.heading: TECHNICAL DETAILS
details.domains: Internet addresses quoted in the code
details.outside: Points outside the tools (startup, installation, package)

reportEnd.readOn: This report describes the code read on {date}. It does not prove that a server is safe.
reportEnd.fromCache: Result taken from an analysis of {date}.

report.backToTop: Back to the top of the page
report.pasteAbove: Paste its link in the field at the top of the page.
